recognize_zh: 血液抹片中一顆小型顆粒球，核未分葉、呈圓形且染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡灰帶細小顆粒；「成熟染色質卻不分葉」的圓核中性球即類 Pelger 樣變化（pseudo-Pelger-Huët），是 MDS 顆粒球發育不良的線索。
features: Small granulocyte with a round, non-lobated nucleus and coarsely clumped mature chromatin
Pale grey-blue cytoplasm with sparse fine granules (hypogranular)
Mild red cell anisocytosis with occasional ovalocytes and teardrop-like forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte with a round, non-segmented nucleus containing coarsely clumped mature chromatin and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm, consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huet (non-lobated) neutrophil. The red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional ovalocytes. Scattered platelets are present, and no blasts are seen. The findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis, supporting a myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of clear blue agranular cytoplasm, whereas this cell has broader grey granular neutrophilic cytoplasm and blocky segmented-type chromatin.
Immature granulocytes have finer chromatin and more abundant specific granules rather than condensed chromatin with hypogranular cytoplasm.
The inherited anomaly involves nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation and no cytopenias.
